subject.title: feat: add Hermes Agent connector example

question: Should ClickClack own and maintain a production-shaped Hermes-specific connector under examples, including its supporting SDK and API surface?
rationale: The branch is broader than illustrative sample code and establishes a third-party integration, CI burden, operational contract, and new SDK/API behavior without maintainer direction in the discussion.

options.title: Adopt as maintained example
options.body: Accept the Hermes connector as a supported repository example after runtime proof and focused compatibility and security review.

options.title: Keep only generic primitives
options.body: Land independently useful SDK and API capabilities while moving the Hermes-specific bridge to an external repository or package.

options.title: Decline the integration
options.body: Close the PR if ClickClack does not want vendor-specific production connectors in this repository.

recommendation.title: Keep only generic primitives
recommendation.body: Land independently useful SDK and API capabilities while moving the Hermes-specific bridge to an external repository or package.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest available history signal covers the realtime, bot-scope, and delivery boundaries expanded by this PR.
